_comment: Phase http_request_cache_settings (Cache Rules). Pro limit: 25 rules. The Flutter build has NO content-hashed file names, so only the versioned /fonts/fallback/vNN/ paths get a long TTL. Pages already caches its own assets and purges them on deploy; zone-level edge TTLs on unversioned files would serve stale files after a deploy.

rules.description: [pro] site: bypass zone cache for unversioned app files (shell, SW, bootstrap, consent, manifest, privacy, main.dart.js, assets)
rules.expression: (http.host in {"artimer.win" "www.artimer.win"} and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/fonts/fallback/") and not http.request.uri.path.extension in {"png" "jpg" "jpeg" "gif" "webp" "ico"})

rules.description: [pro] site: versioned fallback fonts, 1 year at the edge
